authority: Agent adjudication under explicit maintainer delegation in this conversation
prior_continuation_authorization_exact: 继续当前任务，并在当前任务完成后完成所有后续开发并提交至main。
decision_maker: coding agent acting on the delegated D-G A/B decision
rationale: A keeps the accepted repository-wide existential exact-credit contract and the existing D-M/D-M-S treatment of known capture gaps. A supported include cut off before capture can hide a real exact declaration; final graph membership distinguishes this from already captured cycles, excluded nodes and stale per-root depth diagnostics. B is a valid alternative policy retaining the bounded-view warning, but leaves this known gap unresolved.
accepted_scope: Only normalized supported include targets in readable captured nodes that remain absent from the final node map after all roots, under the unchanged depth limit of 10. Consume the new internal tuple after exact/qualified credit, D-F/D-S, D-L and D-M/D-M-S, and before the existing warning.
accepted_compatibility_costs: A target is not asserted to exist, be readable or pass candidate/physical-path checks; no new probe is permitted.
An unrelated subproject frontier can conservatively replace every remaining used-but-uncredited critical-package warning with SKIPPED/INFO.
An isolated warning or promoted CRITICAL gate can change from exit 1 to 0; independent qualifying findings still control their own exit result.
Default text can show PASS with skipped counts, default export hides SKIP, and complete JSON retains the reason; renderers are unchanged.
acceptance_requirement: Keep all original P-A bytes. Add actual deep-first and reverse-order regressions with root/read-order assertions; write failing acceptance tests before implementation; complete final quality, fresh five-project Gate A, affected commands, push main and verify exact-head CI.
excluded: new file reads, probes, candidates, roots, grammar, budgets or lock credit
engine, scanner, redaction, persisted schemas, dependencies or package version changes
automatic acceptance of other OPEN R07-C policies
paid APIs, GPU resource validation, application submission and release
